senses.gloss: (denom. of רֵיקָן; cmp. דַּאֲבָן denom. of דַּאֲבוֹנָא) to empty, drain.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24:7">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> (ref. to <he>להצילך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 23:15">Deut. XXIII, 15</cite>) <he>לרוֹקֵן כל נכסי וכ׳</he> to drain all the stores of the nations and give them to thee.—V. <cite ref="T00706"><he>רִיקִן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 37:24">Gen. XXXVII, 24</cite>) <he>נ׳ בורו של יעקב</he> Jacob’s well was emptied (his children were bare of virtues).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 10:2">Ned. X, 2</cite> <he>מת האב לא נִתְרוֹקְנָה וכ׳</he> with the father’s death his authority (to interfere with the daughter’s vows) does not go over to her husband; <cite ref="Nedarim 68b">ib. 68ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Nedarim 6:2">Tosef. ib. VI, 2</cite>, sq.

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 153:6">Sifré Num. 153</cite> <he>שאין הרשות מִתְרוֹקֶנֶת וכ׳</he> to whom the father’s authority cannot be transferred; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 785:4">Yalk. ib. 785</cite>.
